scripts.dev: node -e "process.env.EXPO_NO_DEPENDENCY_VALIDATION='1'; const os=require('os'); const net=require('net'); const {spawn}=require('child_process'); function isPrivateIPv4(ip){return /^10\.|^192\.168\.|^172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[0-1])\./.test(ip);} function getBestIPv4(){const ifaces=os.networkInterfaces(); const avoid=/(virtual|vmware|hyper\-v|vethernet|loopback|tailscale|tap|npcap)/i; for(const [name,addrs] of Object.entries(ifaces)){ if(avoid.test(name)) continue; for(const a of (addrs||[])){ if(a && a.family==='IPv4' && !a.internal && isPrivateIPv4(a.address)) return a.address; } } for(const addrs of Object.values(ifaces)){ for(const a of (addrs||[])){ if(a && a.family==='IPv4' && !a.internal) return a.address; } } return null;} const host=getBestIPv4(); if(host) process.env.REACT_NATIVE_PACKAGER_HOSTNAME=host; function checkPort(p){return new Promise(r=>{const s=net.createServer(); s.once('error',()=>r(false)); s.once('listening',()=>s.close(()=>r(true))); s.listen({ port:p, host:'0.0.0.0', exclusive:true });});} (async()=>{let port=8081; while(port<8100 && !(await checkPort(port))) port++; const args=['expo','start','--lan','--port',String(port)]; spawn('npx', args, { stdio:'inherit', shell:true, env:process.env }); })().catch(e=>{console.error(e); process.exit(1);});"
